sense.text: “All scripture is given by inspiration of God”: it is given to inspire us. “And is profitable”, beneficial, “for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness”.

“That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.” Our heavenly Father expects us to be perfect. Our King wants us to be a carbon copy of himself, and that is only found in the scriptures.
“Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us.” Believe it or not, we are amongst our fathers right now: the spirit of our forefathers is with the bishops and the deacons.

“The Lord hath wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning. Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies”.

That is why it is important to be around these renowned men, these great men. You will learn a lot and be soaked in the wisdom. The spirit of the wisdom of God is amongst these mighty men: they are saturated in the Lord’s wisdom, they have the experience, they are well travelled.

“And whatsoever ye do in word or deed”: word and deed have to be one and the same. “Do all in the name of the Lord Jesus.” If you call yourself a godly man, a prophet or an evangelist, your word and your deed have to match. That goes into your character and your mannerisms too: are you exhibiting the laws of God? Are you about the work, or are you a keyboard warrior, safe behind the computer? If you are part of an organization that is all talk, get out of there. They are not the ones to be around.

On the missions our works and our deeds line up. The men went out and cleaned up the community, because we cannot expect the heathens or any other nation to do it for us. As men we are ordained to do the work: clean up our communities, clean up the minds of our people, protect and serve them. There were many churches around that neighborhood, and not one time did they have the idea to clean up their own community.

In Haiti the question was put to the people: where are your pastors, where are your voodoo priests? All that is seen in the streets is a bunch of purple shirts waking the people up, telling them who they are and reconnecting them back to their God. If a man does not exhibit those things, if his word and his deed do not match and he is not a man of action, God is not dealing with him. Come up out of those churches. Your pastor is not about this work.

“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost”. A lot of times we read this and think it was just a suggestion by our King. It is not a suggestion, it is a commandment. Brothers that do not have a passport without a good reason: this is a commandment.

Christianity jacked this up, saying, see, all nations. No: the nation it is referring to is the twelve tribes of Israel that were scattered abroad.

So travel. Get your passports and be about the work. This is how the men of the Lord vacate: no umbrella in the cups, but bottled water and towels wiping away the sweat while pushing the gospel to the people, informing the lost sheep of Israel who they are.

precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations”: this is why Christ said go ye therefore and teach all nations. His people are scattered amongst all nations.

“And ye shall be left few in number among the heathen.” Why? Because of our disobedience to our God.

sense.text:
The history is being removed, just as the Bishop brought out last Sabbath. It is being removed from the school system here in America, in Babylon, and the same thing is going on in the third world countries: asked simple questions about history, the children, even high schoolers, don’t know it. Slowly they want to remove the history. But we have a commandment to constantly remind our people, so we cannot give them a break. Israel, we have to stand on our square and make sure our people are privy to their history.

“Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.” That is our duty. We must show our people their history, the same history they shun and are embarrassed about. We have to put it in their face and constantly remind them. Yes, we are the descendants of the slave trade, but it was by God’s design. He ordained it, because of our disobedience.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”. You shall see your teachers. The Lord orchestrated it so that we will see our teachers.

That is why he commands us to be on the highways and byways, the chief places of concourse where the people are moving about, the people that block their ears from hearing the commandments of God. He commanded us to go and reach the lost tribes and teach them that they need to repent and come back to their nationality.

“And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying”. Why is it behind them? Because they are walking past. They hear the word behind them because we are a rebellious people: they want to stop their ears from hearing the gospel.

precepts.why:
This is why they hear it behind them: “But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder”. Brother, we have to listen. We have the greatest history; you are the chosen people of God. And what do they do? They pull away the shoulder: get away from me with that. “And stopped their ears, that they should not hear. Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law”.

Brother, you need to stop that ritual. That is not of God, that is not your heritage. What do you mean it is not our heritage? They stop their ears, so the Lord sends the teachers out where the people walk, and the word comes behind them.

sense.text:
The leadership met with the commissioner in Haiti, and the goal was to build, just as it is commanded. “Thus saith the Lord God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen”: he cast us far off amongst the heathen. “And although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary”.

That is our job and our vision. We take the same vision that was documented in the scriptures and make it tangible for our people to actually see. We are not about lip service: we read it and we apply it.

“I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered”. That is the end result. Through these sanctuaries being built, the Lord will eventually deliver his people from their captivity. That is our mission.

The papers lie about why we came, and that is why we stay on our A game and address these things. Many people sound like they are for their people, and some truly are, but the missing formula is the commandments. They have a great zeal to serve God and a vision for their people, but not according to knowledge.

When we sat down with the gang leader Barbecue, our duty was to warn him: you are from the tribe of Levi, you are bound to the duties to serve your people, and you have to apply the laws. If you genuinely want to build and unite your people, it has to be on the foundation of Christ. If it is not found in Christ, it will not work. There will be no unity unless it is under the banner of the Israelites. If it is not the commandments of God, forget about it. We were there to warn our people of the coming judgment and of the mindset they must have to restore the people, under the banner of Christ.

“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” No light. I don’t care what organization you have going on for the people, it is not going to work.

His main thing was a seat at the table to negotiate the affairs of Haiti. But as the Bishop brought out, you cannot negotiate with a demonic nation whose agenda is to destroy us and take the resources. You cannot negotiate with a venomous serpent. His group’s name means live together, and that sounds good and powerful, but the key element is the commandments of God. Without them, it ain’t going nowhere.

This is what it is to try to negotiate with a demonic nation: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”. Who had that perpetual hatred? Go up to verse 2: “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. Mount Seir is Esau, Edom, the so-called white man today, and his hatred against us takes many forms.

“And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. Today it is the gun, and they still use the hanging system: many of our brothers and sisters have been hanged because of this perpetual hatred.

The hatred is real. As soon as we do the work and sit down with dignitaries to seek the affairs of our people, right on the back end they use their devices of Satan to put out a photo implicating us as sitting down with the oppressors, the same nation that hates us.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” It is a bloody nation, bloodthirsty, with a blood lust. The Lord says, the same way you love that blood, blood shall pursue you. Nobody loves blood more than the Lord. He is the creator of that blood.
“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate”. Mount Seir is the government: your government will be desolate.

precepts.why: Who dwelt in mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So Genesis explains who the Lord is speaking to in Ezekiel 35. He is speaking about Edom, Esau: the so-called white man today.

sense.text:
These are the hidden rulers of Haiti: the oligarch families that control all the export and import and all the businesses that make a country function, and that pay gang members to destabilize the area and run their business. This brings the scripture to life: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”.

When we go out and teach a certain country or nation, this is what we are fighting against: the ones sitting high over the country and all the evils they are doing. We point it out and say, this is wrong, God is going to judge you. If you want to see what Satan looks like, you are seeing them right now. That is the family with perpetual hatred against God’s people, and the so-called Haitians are from the tribe of Levi. The Bible is a true book: we are at constant war with Esau, Edom. That is what the whole fight is about.

A principality is a territory ruled by a prince, and in the scriptures it also stands for human governments, magistrates and political rulers. These are the powers: the deep state the Bishop brought out, the hidden families, the oligarchs. An oligarch is an extremely wealthy and powerful individual who uses his money, business control or elite status to exert direct influence over a country’s politics and government. Only the few rule, and they use the gangs, other countries, sometimes the military, to enforce it. They are paid. They want to stay hidden, but they move and control these countries. This is not a war about guns, knives and bombs.

If they rule Haiti and they are rich, and Haiti is in chaos, why does it stay that way? Because they want it that way. Nothing moves without them. Build a restaurant or a business, and the family that runs that sector will pay someone to burn it down. Haiti is known for coffee and sugar and can grow its own rice, yet it is forced to import its food. A pastor in Haiti who grew and packaged his own rice was arrested for months for no reason at all. Because these oligarchs control the exports, Haiti is not allowed to trade.

This is why we cannot have anybody with a weak, fearful spirit around us. When it is time to go, we have work to do, and we have to answer the call, because our King already gave the word. “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”. It says go: that is an order. Go and teach. That is why we don’t have time to play around and debate. The hell with your debate, we have work to do.

You have to be ready to battle, ready to go and risk your life. Look at the work of these renowned men: they put their bid in and jeopardize their lives to do the work.

precepts.why:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries”: against many countries, against the evils going on there, the oligarchs. That is the work of the prophets, and that is what we have been sent to do.

“And against great kingdoms”. Babylon the Great is a great kingdom, and it does much wickedness. “Of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” These are the subjects we must cry against these kingdoms. We cannot be scared to do the work, and we cannot be afraid to speak against the atrocities being set up against the children of Israel.

sense.text:
Haiti’s puppet masters: a nation run for a century by a few families who profit from chaos, and power handed not to an elected leader but to an unelected businessman, with American warships anchored offshore to ensure Washington’s preferred outcome. The term for these puppets is vassal kings: a senior power hand-picks who will govern a conquered nation, and the vassal owes it allegiance and tribute. Herod was a vassal king, an Edomite, Idumean king put in place by Rome to govern over Israel, and America is an extension of Rome. Most of the time they make sure the puppet is light-skinned, to rule over a dark nation. All that democracy, voting, right wing and left wing is an illusion: the elites don’t care about democracy, they care about power.

When President Aristide was asked about the charge that he was inciting the lower classes against the ruling elite, the Edomite was saying, how dare you, as a president, go against the ruling power? I thought the president was the ruling power. That don’t make no damn sense. What does it have to do with you, white man? But they don’t like to stay home; they want to be in everybody’s business.

Read verse 1: it is speaking of the Romans. “Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace: finally, that they were greatly exalted”. The whole purpose is to uphold their system. If you side with their policies and their politics, you will rule. If not, they displace you: that is a coup d’état. That is their spirit. They think they are your father, like the Edomite strolling up to a group of black folks minding their own business: what are you guys doing? The audacity of these demons.

Aristide, and many of our people, think we can go into government and change it, but we don’t know the levels of the evils of Esau. Jovenel Moïse died. Aristide was displaced the first time, and came back humbled, because he forgot his place. He said himself the United States forced him to leave, in a coup and a kidnapping. It is the same tactic Rome used, because they are the same people, and it is the same MO today: assassinate you, or put a bag over your head and take you out. Whoever won’t play ball, they replace, assassinate or overthrow. Every ruling person with an opportunity to gather the people, if he does not have the formula of the commandments, it will not work.

A president of a country, exiled, says he will go back to Haiti if they allow him to leave. A man wants to go back to his own country and he can’t do it. You can’t tell me slavery is not still there, or that we are not still oppressed. And those with the razor-thin lips ask why Haiti can’t be built: because you are the one plotting against it.

“Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?”

“The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor”. What does Haiti have? It has the resources. Take them and leave the people alone; but no, it is that perpetual hatred. It is in their DNA. They can’t shake it. “Let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.”

“For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth. The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.” God is nowhere in their thoughts. The only god they have is guns, oil and drugs: that is the white man’s god. Even when he opens his lips to say God bless America, know which god he is talking about. He is talking about Satan.

“His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them. He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved”. That is the pride, American pride. “For I shall never be in adversity. His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.”

“He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent”. That is the oligarch family, the deep state. They murder the innocent: a pit full of the bones of missing children was found at one of those families’ mansions, and he has yet to pay or come to justice.

The Lord is reserving these demons for him to tread upon. All the bloodshed has to be paid for, and if you align with them, you will pay with them and be trodden down alongside them. One of those oligarchs has died, at 91: the Lord gave us a gift on his high holy day. One down, many more to come. We don’t have to do anything. But we have to unite under the banner of Christ. We have to get out of the way of the Lord, and the only way to do that is through obedience.

This is how Esau, Edom, the white man, gets down with his government: go in with the Marines, kill the democratically elected leader, put in a puppet, usually very light-skinned, reset the price of bananas, and leave. They did it in Honduras, Nicaragua and Guatemala, and Haiti was just practice: the same agenda across South America and Africa, divide and conquer, send in the Jesuit priests. Once they conquer a land they use the people of that land to work for them, traitors of their own people. And when they kill and destabilize countries, they say it is for the good of their national security. They do not see it as anything wrong.

“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” Fresh out of the womb, they come out speaking lies.

“Their poison is like the poison of a serpent”. That is why you can’t negotiate with a serpent, a snake. They are a nation of demons, and there is no negotiating with them. Barbecue wants to sit at the table to negotiate the affairs of the people, but it is the same mistake a brother from the Black Panther movement pointed to in Martin Luther King: thinking he could negotiate with a nation that would be sympathetic to him. No.

“They are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear”. They don’t want to hear the cries or the bloodshed. They commit genocide in Gaza, Palestine, and drop bombs on an all-girls school, and in their mind it is for the benefit of their people. They don’t see it as evil, when the Lord says that is evil.

If we have to go to bed with a devil to protect our national security, we will: that is your god-fearing country. The closer you align yourself with the ideology of America, the closer you get to Satan. You can’t serve two masters.

There is a committee that meets every week to make a kill list, tasked by the president himself. “And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” This is America. That beast is America. They portray themselves to be godly, a god-fearing country, but on the back end they speak as a dragon: that fire.

Look at the eagle on their seal. In its talons are an olive branch, America seeks peace, and thirteen arrows, prepared to defend liberty: war. When they say they seek peace, they come to destroy. Once they conquer a third world country they put in a vassal king or puppet president, and once that person has the fortitude to stand up for his people, then come the coups, the paid rebellions, the jackals and the assassinations. That is what happened to Jovenel Moïse: when he said Haiti did not need their COVID vaccinations because the people have their natural herbs and remedies, that same week they deported a plane full of infected patients back to Haiti.

precepts.why:
“He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant. The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart”. War was in his heart: all he thinks about is bloodshed. That is all that is in America’s mind, even the citizens: how can I hang this one, three or four ways, and how can I get away with it? Look at law enforcement. They just made a weapons sale to Israel, two-thousand-ton bombs for the next war, and who pays for it? Us, our taxes. It is all set up for war.

“His words were softer than oil”. That is the lamb of Revelation 13:11: two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon. War is in his heart continually. That perpetual hatred is always stirring him up to come against the people of Israel.

Religion is part of the smooth words. A pastor who has made his home in Haiti for decades, owning businesses and working for one of the families, has a ministry that teaches the people in the villages to be comfortable with their poverty, saying Christ wants you to be poor. It is the same thing King Leopold II wrote to his missionaries: find texts that order your followers to love poverty, happier are the poor, it is hard for the rich to enter the kingdom of God; detach them from anything that gives them the courage to affront us; evangelize them so that they stay forever in submission to the white colonialist. They come in subtle, as peacekeepers bringing health products after the earthquake, while on the back end children were being taken wholesale. Missionaries who learn the Creole, speak it better than you, and fascinate the people are being charged with abusing Haitian boys. That is their MO.

Those were the Jesuit priests, and now they are called missionaries. A Jesuit, in its secondary meaning, is a crafty, scheming, deceitful person: the bottom meaning is how they have all behaved since they went into the Congo, coming in as an angel of light. They place themselves in education, social work, human rights and politics, and they target the poor to rile them up and use them later to overthrow governments. Past the smooth words, two men plotted to sail to an island of Haiti, murder all the men and enslave the women and children: the raw, uncut Edom. That is the real hate group, and he must be stopped, and the one to do it is the Lord.

There is video on top of video of their horrors: an Edomite who lived in South Africa for years was found with the vaginas of twenty-one women in his freezer. Remember, they love blood; that is their nature. And our people will still worship the Edomite man when he goes to Africa.

sense.text: “Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” This is the call: the Lord is asking who is going to do it. Who is going to overcome his personal sins and, knowing we are in debt to the Lord, repay him by doing the work? We have to go out and raise up the twelve tribes of Israel that are still stuck in darkness. That is our duty. Who is going to answer that call?

precepts.why:
“Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.” That is the process when you come to serve the Lord: your iniquities are forgiven, and now you are set to do the work.

“Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.” Send me. We just read in Psalms, who will rise up for me? Are you the one to contend against the workers of iniquity? Are you the one who will overcome your personal sins, get cleansed, and then wake up your people still stuck in darkness, celebrating birthdays and doing the customs of the heathen, like our tribe of Levi still stuck in voodoo and witchcraft? Many of us come from that background, but now you are being cleansed with the word.

You are not set to just sit in these purple chairs and marinate, a professional student. You are there to learn, to master, to overcome your sins, and afterwards to teach your people. We have a nation to gather together.

Isaiah asked to be sent, and what was he sent for? “Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression”. As he teaches, he is crying aloud, teaching like a trumpet, not sparing anybody’s sins: this is where you fell off.

“And the house of Jacob their sins.” That is the whole purpose of going to Haiti: stop the voodoo. The commissioner said worship Satan; don’t you remember what happened after you did voodoo? Your whole country went downhill, and now you want to add more to it. That makes no damn sense.

That is why the Bishop always says, show me his video, I want to see the fire coming out of him. We don’t want scared brothers or weak-teaching brothers. You have to be able to give the people the sense. They need to see the power of the Lord exhibited; they want to see this spirit.

This is the only way the fire is going to be on, ready to teach the people and cry aloud: “Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.”

If you see the dilapidated, decayed state of your people, how the oppressor has organized himself to destroy the masses of God’s chosen, and it does not inflame you to speak against it, you are not being used by God. The poverty, the slums, the ghetto, the water situation in Detroit, Michigan: this should be your motivation. That is the zeal you see in the prophets in Detroit, in Ohio, in New York, when they go out into these international countries and see what America and these other countries are doing to oppress our people. That is what the Lord uses.

Jeremiah was fed up. The people did not want to hear it; they spoke against him and plotted to kill him. “Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones”. The word of the Lord needs to be a burning fire in you. That is how the Lord can use you to wake up his people, because we have hard-headed people.

Remember Zechariah: they stop their ears from hearing the law because they don’t want to be corrected. A sister was once told there are laws she needs to abide by, and she ran away: if I hear it, that means I’m marked. The wicked know it, and you will encounter that.

“And I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.” Despite the dangers, despite being dropped in the pit and left to die, Jeremiah went out and taught his people. That is the spirit of the Lord. The Lord is searching out who will rise up for him: do you have that fire, that zeal to contend against the workers of iniquity, to change the minds of your people and plant the seed of righteousness? Then watch the Lord take over.

sense.text:
Their own policy says any country that develops economically or militarily must be considered an enemy and kept down, even China. America is a wealthy nation; if it were truly godly it would help the weaker countries, but no, it wants them to stay down. Over and over the Lord is revealing the man of sin. And people say China is going to be the next superpower. False: it is the Israelites. God’s kingdom will reign. America can do its worst, but it cannot stop the coming kingdom of Christ.

“And in the days of these kings”: the puppet kings, the oligarchs, “shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people”. It won’t be left to China, to Russia or to America. The Lord’s kingdom will be established.

“But it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”: they will be under foot, under the rulership of God, under the Israelites.

Now to the title of the class: true unity will only be found amongst the Israelites. “Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.” Paul’s focus is Israel. Don’t let anybody confuse you: the Gentiles he went to are Israelites, the northern kingdom of Israel.

“For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.” Our brothers had a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge. That is the missing element, the missing formula for our deliverance. We must be unified under the banner of our King and his commandments. The commandments are our constitution, and they will be used to unify Israel, not any other nation or group.

The Zealots were a Jewish patriotic party in the time of Cyrenius that resisted Roman aggression and, in their hatred of the Romans, resorted to violence and assassination. Rome was oppressing Israel, so they formed groups to attack Rome, thinking deliverance would come by might. But that time was done, because we went into captivity for our disobedience to the laws of God.

The same pattern is in every organization our people have formed against oppression. The Black Panthers, infiltrated and divided, their members killed and imprisoned. The Brown Berets, who fed and defended their people, until the feminist movement and the forerunner of the LGBT movement crept in, the women wanting to take the roles of the men, and the conflicts weakened their unity. The American Indian Movement, worn down by investigations and arrests. The armed coalition whose leader was sent to federal prison. A great zeal, but not according to knowledge. They have the skin, but they don’t have the spirit, the breath of God, in them yet.

In Haiti, they were asked about 1804: you got your victory, but who did you give the honor and glory to? They said it was due to witchcraft. Immediately France came knocking for its money.

precepts.why:
This is the contract the Lord made with our forefathers: “And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you. And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.”

“But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments”, “I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror”. “And ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you”. That is what happened. Those that reigned over us slew us. Even when we assembled ourselves and mustered up the courage to battle, the Lord was not with us, and to this day he is not with us, because we did not keep the covenant. We are still in Christianity, still subject to the other nations, still celebrating birthdays. We don’t even identify our God.

If kidnappers took your child, and you went to deliver him, but the child no longer recognized you, could you deliver him? No. That is the issue now: we forgot how our God looks and fell for the false image. When we go to reconnect our people with the true description of their God, they buck up against it, because they have been deceived and have broken the covenant. They cannot be delivered, because they have forgotten their God and been disconnected from their heritage.

“And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.” We have been devoured in the land of our enemies.

There were zealots in the Bible who thought they could do the same thing. “For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody”: not trusting in the Lord. “To whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.”

“After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him”: another group of zealots, against Caesar, Rome, the ruling power that was doing the taxing. “He also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.” The zealots never worked, because way back then God told Zerubbabel, not by might.

Israel’s problem was a moral issue, a spiritual problem. We were not keeping the covenant of our King, and when we broke it, the judgment and the curses fell upon us. “This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might”: not by the sword, “nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” Our victory comes through the spirit, through our obedience to the commandments of God. Then our victory is secured.

This is the reason we don’t take up arms. We are fighting a different level of fight, a spiritual fight. “Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight”: then would my servants be zealots. “But now is my kingdom not from hence.” Christ said it himself: not by might, but by my spirit.

“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God”. There is no AK-47; the blick is not going to work against this demon. He made it. The sword is his blessing, and now he has bombs and drones he can fly like a video game, sitting in a shed eating his cookies while he drops a bomb on you. Modern warfare. The Lord has to step down and do it.

Our warfare is spiritual, and we gain our victory through the unification of Israel under the banner of our King. It will not work any other way. The Zealots took up arms and rose up in 66, but Rome came with Titus, laid siege to Jerusalem in 70, and the temple went up in flames; the rebels at Masada killed themselves rather than be captured. It did not work.

This is what Christ was warning about. “For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled”: what we read in Leviticus 26.

“For there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people. And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”. There was nothing the Zealots could have done to save the people or fight for them. “And shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”. In 70 AD Rome wiped them out. Our deliverance comes through our King.

The Black Panthers had a good zeal, but not according to knowledge, and the big payback is going to come from the hand of our King, not from them. What is the knowledge? “For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth”.

That should have been all the heads of those organizations, leading with the constitution, which is the Holy Bible. As a mustard seed the nation of Israel will be gathered, but we underestimate the scriptures and cast them behind us, and the nations devour us. Our power is the scriptures. Our defense is the Bible. That is the missing key element.

“In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.” When Haiti won the 1804 revolution, they never acknowledged the Lord. They gave the honor to Satan, to their ceremony, and immediately the Lord jacked them up. That is what happened to most of these organizations: they do not acknowledge God or the constitution. The only deliverance is going to come through the Israelites.

The heathen hate it. “When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.” The nations hate that: you are trying to stop the oppression machine. That is why the FBI could not leave these movements alone.

Many of our brothers go into politics thinking they are going to make a change, but politics is not our religion. Politics is the white man’s religion, and they use it to oppress us. Start a food giveaway, and they ask, do you have the proper permits? They make policies to stop the aid, because they want us under foot continually.

sense.text:
This warfare is not with swords or guns. This is how it is going to be won: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. We must realize that we are that nation not desired: constantly oppressed, downtrodden, hung. They have systems of oppression all over the planet so that they win continually. But there is a God in Israel. Only a fool lets somebody else tell him who his enemy is: they call others terrorists, but they are the number one terrorist, hanging us wholesale, taking our history out of the schools and giving us the false image.

The kingdom is within us, so we have to draw our resources together and have that one mind. Not a Baptist here, a Pentecostal there, a witch here, a hippie Hebrew there: one mind, one God. They created the condition Haiti is in and then mock the people for standing around, but if twenty men there put their hands together, they have the capacity to rebuild a block, one building at a time.

“Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” Understand, he is angry right now, because he wants to come and deliver his people.

precepts.why:
“The kingdom of God cometh not with observation: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” It is in us. We have the zeal to gather together, but it has to be executed properly. No kingdom functions without laws, statutes, heritage and customs; without them it is not a kingdom.

We were scattered because we disobeyed. The Lord did it; he separated us. But our power is to unify, and he commands it.

This is our King’s desire: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!” We would not. He constantly wants to deliver; he is itching to deliver his people. But it takes us understanding that our deliverance is right there, within us. We need to gather in one mind, under one banner, under Christ.

“But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God; From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.” He is not coming back to dance on the tulips. He is coming for war, to deliver his people. The Lord is expecting it.

“Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people, And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us”: for us, “in the house of his servant David”, “That we should be saved from our enemies”: the same enemies the Lord is expecting to be made his footstool, “and from the hand of all that hate us”: that perpetual hatred.

“To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant; The oath which he sware to our father Abraham, That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear”. Today we have to beg and lie to these bosses to get days off to keep the feast days of our God. But the time is coming when that is over: the nations will be under foot, and they will be the ones begging for days off. This is war.

“O Jerusalem, look about thee toward the east, and behold the joy that cometh unto thee from God. Lo, thy sons come, whom thou sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of God.”

“Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains”: the land will be at rest and rejoice once we are in our rightful position. “For the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted. But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.”

Listen to what the Lord says: “Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.” He will not forget, because he knows what happened. We are only on a temporary time-out, until we remember and repent of our sins so that he can come and deliver us and fight for us. “Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands”.

“Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee. Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee.”
“My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee; but shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck.”
